# Case Study: Immuno-Oncology Biomarkers and Trial Endpoints

Immune checkpoint inhibitors (anti-PD-1 / anti-PD-L1) have altered treatment paradigms in solid tumors. This case study illustrates an integrated clinical trial reporting workflow combining survival outcomes, subgroup hazard ratios, RECIST 1.1 response kinetics, and swimmer timelines.

## Clinical Trial Background

In a randomized Phase III trial evaluating anti-PD-1 immunotherapy versus standard chemotherapy in advanced non-small cell lung cancer, primary endpoints include Overall Survival (OS) and Objective Response Rate (ORR). Key predictive biomarkers include tumor PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Score (TPS: $<1\%$, $1\text{--}49\%$, $\ge 50\%$).

## Step 1: Overall Survival (Kaplan-Meier with Aligned Risk Table)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(cliomicplot)
library(survival)
library(ggplot2)

clitheme("nature")

p_km <- cliplot(
  Surv(time, status) ~ sex,
  data = lung,
  type = type_km(
    risk_table  = TRUE,
    pval        = TRUE,
    conf_int    = TRUE,
    median_line = TRUE,
    milestones  = c(180, 365)
  ),
  palette  = "nature",
  title    = "Overall Survival",
  subtitle = "Landmark Milestones at 6 & 12 Months",
  ylab     = "Survival Probability"
)
p_km
```

## Step 2: Treatment Consistency Across PD-L1 Subgroups (Forest Plot)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
io_subgroups <- data.frame(
  Variable = c("Overall Intention-to-Treat", "PD-L1 TPS >= 50%", "PD-L1 TPS 1-49%", "PD-L1 TPS < 1%"),
  HR       = c(0.68, 0.49, 0.72, 0.91),
  CI_low   = c(0.55, 0.36, 0.54, 0.71),
  CI_high  = c(0.84, 0.67, 0.96, 1.16),
  P        = c(0.0004, 0.0001, 0.024, 0.420)
)

clitheme("nature")

p_forest <- cliplot(
  HR ~ Variable,
  data = io_subgroups,
  type = type_forest(
    ref_line    = TRUE,
    ref_val     = 1.0,
    sort        = TRUE,
    stripe      = TRUE,
    show_values = TRUE
  ),
  title    = "Subgroup Consistency",
  subtitle = "Hazard Ratios Across PD-L1 Strata"
) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 25, b = 4, l = 10, "pt"))
p_forest
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](18-case-study-cancer-immunotherapy_files/figure-html/io-forest-1.png){width=2400}
:::
:::


## Step 3: Tumor Burden Kinetics (Waterfall Plot)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(42)
n_eval <- 24
pat_ids <- paste0("PT-", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_eval))
changes <- sort(rnorm(n_eval, mean = -22, sd = 36), decreasing = TRUE)

wf_io <- data.frame(
  Patient = factor(pat_ids, levels = pat_ids),
  Change  = changes
)

clitheme("nature")

p_wf <- cliplot(
  Change ~ Patient,
  data = wf_io,
  type = type_waterfall(
    show_labels         = FALSE,
    response_thresholds = c("PD" = 20, "PR" = -30),
    bar_width           = 0.72
  ),
  title    = "Tumor Burden Response",
  subtitle = "RECIST 1.1 Criteria (PD: +20%, PR: -30%)"
) +
  labs(
    x = "Individual Patients (n = 24, ranked by change)",
    y = "Best % Change in Target Lesions"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x    = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 6.5),
    legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
    plot.margin     = margin(t = 6, r = 8, b = 4, l = 4, "pt")
  )

p_wf
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](18-case-study-cancer-immunotherapy_files/figure-html/io-waterfall-1.png){width=2550}
:::
:::


## Step 4: Swimmer Plot of Treatment Duration


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(123)
imtrial <- data.frame(
  Patient  = factor(pat_ids, levels = pat_ids),
  Duration = sort(runif(n_eval, 4, 32)),
  BestResp = sample(c("CR", "PR", "SD", "PD"), n_eval, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.15, 0.35, 0.30, 0.20)),
  Ongoing  = sample(c(TRUE, FALSE), n_eval, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.45, 0.55))
)

clitheme("nature")

p_swim <- cliplot(
  Duration ~ Patient,
  data = imtrial,
  type = type_swimmer(
    bar_fill      = "BestResp",
    ongoing       = "Ongoing",
    bar_linewidth = 2.6
  ),
  bar_palette = "jama",
  title       = "Treatment Duration",
  subtitle    = "Ongoing Response at Database Cutoff",
  ylab        = "Months from Enrollment"
) +
  labs(x = "Time on Study (months)", y = "Patients (n = 24)") +
  theme(
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 5.2),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 6.5),
    legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
    plot.margin     = margin(t = 6, r = 8, b = 4, l = 4, "pt")
  )

p_swim
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](18-case-study-cancer-immunotherapy_files/figure-html/io-swimmer-1.png){width=2550}
:::
:::


## Step 5: Multi-Panel Trial Outcome Composite


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(patchwork)

p_composite <- (p_km | p_forest) / (p_wf | p_swim) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1.0, 1.1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "a",
    tag_prefix = "(",
    tag_suffix = ")"
  )

p_composite
```
